stations.title: The desk
stations.text: Bills copied by hand, lined up with a ruler.

stations.title: The files
stations.text: A straight sheet, and a log of every day.

captions: Ambrose wants the day's bills on a sheet with straight columns, and a line in the log.
Today he copies every bill by hand at closing time and lines them up with a ruler.
You write one bill line, then the whole sheet to a file, then add a day to the log.
The program writes the sheet in columns, and the log keeps every day before today.
Ambrose's sheet and logbook are files now, written by the program at closing time.
